dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Visible as a single, thick, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence with sharp, well-defined white longitudinal boundaries along the edges of the dark gray flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A rectangular-shaped pale patch is visible on the posterior neck, bordering the black crown.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Extremely distinct and sharp linear transition between the black crown and the pale nape region.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast black crown and white auricular/cheek region.
